english.note: Use 故意 as the all-purpose adjective for something done intentionally or on purpose.
Use this when the action was intentional rather than accidental, not when it merely reflects free choice.
Use 故意 when an action is intentional or deliberate, not when someone is merely awake or aware.

examples.english: Their refusal to let me in was deliberate.
examples.jyutping: keoi5 gu3 ji3 m4 bei2 ngo5 jap6 mun4 gaa3

examples.english: Breaking the window was voluntary and not accidental.
examples.traditional: 打爛塊玻璃係故意，唔係意外。
examples.jyutping: daa2 laan6 faai3 bo1 lei4 hai6 gu3 ji3 m4 hai6 ji3 ngoi6

examples.english: You deliberately broke the cup, fully conscious of what you were doing.
examples.jyutping: nei5 hai6 gu3 ji3 zing2 laan6 go3 bui1 gaa3
